TaskLibrary.Description: XCGF standard library: movement tasks of the kinematic equipments, modelled on the CMO movement orders (plot course, throttle and altitude settings, station keeping, return to base, take-off and landing). Kinematic and FixedWingKinematic reference them through TaskRef; derived kinematics inherit them. See docs/tasks/kinematics.md.

TaskDefinition.name: MoveTo
TaskDefinition.Description: Move to a geographic position, then end. CMO: a course with a single waypoint.

Parameter.name: Executor
Parameter.Description: Entity that moves. Defaults to the carrier of the task.

Parameter.name: Throttle
Parameter.Description: Throttle setting held during the move, as in CMO. Ignored when Speed is set.

Parameter.name: Speed
Parameter.Description: Speed held during the move. When set, it takes precedence over Throttle. A kinematic bounds it by its own limits.

Parameter.name: TravelTime
Parameter.Description: Time actually spent reaching the destination, set by the task when it ends.

Parameter.name: Destination
Parameter.Description: Point to reach. Its altitude is the altitude to hold on the way (ignored by surface kinematics).

TaskDefinition.name: FollowCourse
TaskDefinition.Description: Fly or drive through a list of waypoints, in order. CMO: plotted course.

Parameter.name: Executor
Parameter.Description: Entity that follows the course. Defaults to the carrier of the task.

Parameter.name: Throttle
Parameter.Description: Throttle setting on the legs whose waypoint gives no speed.

Parameter.name: Loop
Parameter.Description: Whether the course restarts from its first waypoint once the last one is reached. The task then only ends when cancelled.

Parameter.name: Waypoints
Parameter.Description: Waypoints to go through, in order, each with its position (altitude included) and the speed to hold on the leg ending at it.

Parameter.name: CurrentWaypoint
Parameter.Description: Index of the waypoint headed for. Set to choose the starting waypoint; the task updates it as each waypoint is reached.

TaskDefinition.name: HoldPosition
TaskDefinition.Description: Stay at the current position. A kinematic that cannot stop (a fixed-wing aircraft) circles around it at loiter throttle. CMO: all stop, or orbit in place.

Parameter.name: Executor
Parameter.Description: Entity that holds. Defaults to the carrier of the task.

Parameter.name: Duration
Parameter.Description: How long to hold. When absent, the entity holds until the task is cancelled.

Parameter.name: HoldPoint
Parameter.Description: Position held, set by the task when it starts (the position of the executor at that time).

TaskDefinition.name: SetAltitude
TaskDefinition.Description: Climb or descend to an altitude and hold it, keeping the current heading. CMO: altitude setting (preset or exact altitude, terrain following).

Parameter.name: Executor
Parameter.Description: Aircraft that changes altitude. Defaults to the carrier of the task.

Parameter.name: Altitude
Parameter.Description: Altitude to reach: above mean sea level, or above ground level when TerrainFollowing is set. The kinematic caps it at its ceiling.

Parameter.name: TerrainFollowing
Parameter.Description: Whether Altitude is a height above ground the aircraft keeps by following the terrain.

Parameter.name: VerticalSpeed
Parameter.Description: Vertical speed of the climb or descent. When absent, the aircraft climbs at its climb rate.

TaskDefinition.name: Orbit
TaskDefinition.Description: Fly a circle or a racetrack around a station. CMO: station keeping, or the racetrack of a patrol or support mission.

Parameter.name: Executor
Parameter.Description: Aircraft that orbits. Defaults to the carrier of the task.

Parameter.name: Throttle
Parameter.Description: Throttle setting on station. Ignored when Speed is set.

Parameter.name: Speed
Parameter.Description: Speed on station. When set, it takes precedence over Throttle.

Parameter.name: Duration
Parameter.Description: Time on station, counted from the arrival at the station. When absent, the aircraft orbits until the task is cancelled.

Parameter.name: Center
Parameter.Description: Centre of the circle, or of the racetrack; its altitude is the orbit altitude.

Parameter.name: Radius
Parameter.Description: Radius of the circle, or of the turns of the racetrack.

Parameter.name: LegLength
Parameter.Description: Length of the straight legs of the racetrack; 0 flies a circle.

Parameter.name: LegHeading
Parameter.Description: Heading of the inbound leg of the racetrack, from true north, in [0, 360).

TaskDefinition.name: ReturnToBase
TaskDefinition.Description: Fly back to the base and end overhead it; landing is a separate task (Land). CMO: RTB, ordered or triggered when the fuel falls to the bingo level.

Parameter.name: Executor
Parameter.Description: Aircraft that returns. Defaults to the carrier of the task.

Parameter.name: Throttle
Parameter.Description: Throttle setting on the way back; Cruise flies the best range.

Parameter.name: Base
Parameter.Description: Position of the base (runway threshold or carrier position); its altitude is the field elevation.

Parameter.name: BingoFuel
Parameter.Description: Fuel level at which the aircraft must head back to reach the base with its reserve (CMO bingo fuel). When set, the tool starts the task on its own as soon as the fuel on board falls to it. Bounded by the fuel capacity.

TaskDefinition.name: TakeOff
TaskDefinition.Description: Take off from a runway and climb to a first altitude. CMO: launch of an aircraft from its airfield.

Parameter.name: Executor
Parameter.Description: Aircraft that takes off. Defaults to the carrier of the task.

Parameter.name: ClimbAltitude
Parameter.Description: Altitude above the runway at which the take-off ends.

Parameter.name: Runway
Parameter.Description: Threshold of the runway the take-off roll starts from; its altitude is the field elevation.

Parameter.name: RunwayHeading
Parameter.Description: Heading of the runway, from true north, in [0, 360).

Parameter.name: RunwayLength
Parameter.Description: Usable length of the runway. The fixed-wing kinematic requires it to be at least its minimum runway length.

TaskDefinition.name: Land
TaskDefinition.Description: Approach and land on a runway, then stop on it. CMO: landing at the end of an RTB.

Parameter.name: Executor
Parameter.Description: Aircraft that lands. Defaults to the carrier of the task.

Parameter.name: Runway
Parameter.Description: Threshold of the runway the aircraft touches down at; its altitude is the field elevation.

Parameter.name: RunwayHeading
Parameter.Description: Heading of the landing direction, from true north, in [0, 360).

Parameter.name: RunwayLength
Parameter.Description: Usable length of the runway. The fixed-wing kinematic requires it to be at least its minimum runway length.
